title: Dish session v4.B proposed wire contract
description: GM-07.B forward-only proposal. It extends GM-07.A with room preferences, join preview, member submission status and immutable aggregate Top 3 results. It is not a deployed runtime contract.

submittedCount.description: Complete ballots accepted and ACKed by the server for this snapshot's current round only.

memberCount.description: Locked started-session roster size including the host; not online presence and not reduced by disconnects.

canEndWaiting.description: True only for the host while this round is waiting and submittedCount > memberCount / 2; the server rechecks the action.

round1BallotCount.description: Total complete server-ACKed round-one ballots in the scoring cohort; upper bound for any dish score is 2 * round1BallotCount.

errorCode.description: NOT_READY rejects a manual host early-end request before the current-round strict-majority gate is met.
